digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI / Gerrit Verified workflow dispatcher
propositions: Gerrit Verified workflow dispatch-triggered runs dominated the Actions pool during 2026-08-12/13, not tickets-branch pushes, causing two-hour pytest matrix queue delays
Current full-route Verified workflow creates up to 24 runner jobs per patchset with immediate 13-way fan-out, creating peak contention of 22 waiting jobs during incident-period bursts
Organization Free plan limit of 20 concurrent jobs and 5 macOS slots cannot accommodate three simultaneous full-route runs each requesting 13-17 immediate jobs

Repository-local queue depth reached 22 waiting jobs during measured bursts with longest individual job wait time of 873 seconds, while organization-wide contention remains unobservable to this credential
Four mutually exclusive remediation options exist: bundle preflights and cap mutations, coalesce superseded patchsets, move macOS to scheduled health workflow, or upgrade organization plan
Decision brief with cost-benefit analysis and recommendation for Option A (preflight bundling plus mutation cap) is ready pending operator approval before implementation
